# ShelfShot AI

> ShelfShot AI is a web app that turns ordinary product photos into studio-quality ecommerce images using AI. Users upload a product photo, describe the scene in Arabic or English, and receive a generated image with their logo placed inside the scene. It is not affiliated with the ShelfShot Mac app, the Shopify app, or getshelfshot.com.

## Product
- [Home](https://www.shelfshotai.com/en): Product overview, plans, and FAQ
- [Pricing](https://www.shelfshotai.com/en#pricing): Free (3 images/month), Starter $6/month (20 images), Economic $15/month (50 images), Pro $39/month (150 images)
